target: 580 Furtum

source: 580 Theft
target: 580 Furtum

source: Bard pivoted on his heels, fixing his eyes on the door.
target: Bard calcibus versatis, oculos ad ianuam intendens.

source: A moment lingered in silence, but no one rapped against the wooden barrier.
target: Momentum silentii perstitit, sed nemo contra obstaculum ligneum pulsavit.

source: The once-present soft footsteps in the corridor had now faded into nothingness.
target: Gradus molles, quondam in conclavi auditi, nunc in nihilum evanuerant.

source: As a seasoned Beyonder, Bard dismissed the notion of hallucination.
target: Ut peritus Beyonder, Bard notionem hallucinationis neglexit.

source: Returning to the servant’s bed, he grabbed the backpack containing the spoils of the year, feigning an escape from the Governor of the Sea’s residence before confirming the outcome of the sea prayer ritual.
target: Reversus ad lectum servi, sarcinam quae praedas anni contineret cepit, simulans effugium a domicilio Gubernatoris Maris antequam exitum ritus orationis maris confirmaret.

source: Such precautions were only sensible.
target: Talia cautelae vere rationabiles erant.

source: Not everyone placed full trust in Juan Oro’s promises.
target: Non omnes in promissionibus Juan Oro totam fiduciam collocabant.

source: Bard slung the backpack over his shoulder and slyly opened the window, aiming to slip into the weeds below.
target: Bard sarcinam super umerum suum imposuit et callide fenestram aperuit, intendens in herbas se delabi.

source: Suddenly, a figure, standing over a meter tall, emerged from the shadows in the corner.
target: Subito, figura, stans altitudine plusquam unum metrum, ex umbris in angulo emersit.

source: Its disproportionately large head and wrinkled face identified it as one of the Little Devils from the sea spawn.
target: Caput eius, disproportionate magnum, et facies rugosa eum designaverunt ut unum ex Diabolis Parvulis generis maris.

source: The Little Devil gestured for Bard to close the glass window.
target: Diabolus Parvulus indicavit Bard ad fenestram vitream claudendam.

source: Just a bunch of creatures with low IQs, Bard thought, mocking them inwardly.
target: Mere coetus creaturarum parvae ingenii, Bard putavit, eos interioribus ironice deridens.

source: Despite generations, they have yet to master Highlander and can only barely communicate like dogs…
target: Non obstante generationibus, nondum dominati sunt Highlander, et vix ut canes communicare possunt.

source: Maintaining a timid expression, Bard closed the window.
target: Vultu timido servantem, Bard fenestram clausit.

source: Having tested the waters, he had a rough idea of where the sea spawn responsible for monitoring him were hiding.
target: Aquam probato, paene sciebat ubi genera maris, quae eum observabant, se abscondere solebant.

source: None of them appeared to have any connection to the soft footsteps echoing in the corridor, nor did they seem aware of them.
target: Nemo ex illis videbatur aliquam relationem habere cum gradibus mollibus in conclavi resonantibus, nec videbantur eorum conscii esse.

source: On the betrothal boat, Mad Lady, draped in a blood-colored dress with a portion of her face showing pure flesh and blood, instantly vanished upon spotting Mr. K and Lumian.
target: In nave sponsalitia, Mad Lady, induta veste sanguine tincta, cum parte faciei suae puram carnem et sanguinem ostenderet, statim evanuit, cum Mr. K et Lumian conspexit.

source: She swiftly changed her position.
target: Celeriter locum mutavit.

source: Simultaneously, a figure materialized behind and to her side—Lumian and Mr. K.
target: Simul, figura se materializavit post eam et ad latus eius — id est, Lumian et Mr. K.

source: Employing their teleportation abilities, they blocked Mad Lady.
target: Facultatibus teleportationis utentes, Lumian et Mr. K Mad Lady obstraxerunt.

source: After Mad Lady shifted to the opposite side of the deck, the corners of her mouth, made of pure flesh and blood, curled up.
target: Postquam Mad Lady ad contram partem pontis se commovit, anguli oris eius, ex pura carne et sanguine facti, convoluti sunt.

source: Her grayish-green eyes gleamed with anticipation and excitement.
target: Oculi eius, virido-grisei, exspectatione et exsultatione fulgebant.

source: Come and attack me.
target: Veni et me oppugna!

source: Chase me.
target: Persequere me!

source: This way, no one will use the item that honored the ancestors to steal the deep power about to erupt.
target: Hac via, nemo rem, quae maiores honorat, ad furtum potentiae profundae, quae eruptura est, adhibebit.

source: Let’s see who reacts the fastest and ‘teleports’ out of these waters when the time comes!
target: Videamus quis celerissime respondeat et ex his aquis se per translocationem evadat, cum tempus adveniet!

source: For those unable to escape in time, they would undoubtedly be torn to pieces by the violent power, much like the fate that befell others on the ship!
target: Eis qui tempore effugere non possunt, indubitanter a potentia violenta in frusta lacerentur, sicut fatum aliis in nave evenit.

source: As these thoughts raced through her mind, Mad Lady swiftly turned transparent, evading Lumian’s crimson near-white fireballs and Mr. K’s light-green wind blades.
target: Dum hae cogitationes per mentem eius cursabantur, Mad Lady celeriter transparentem facta est, evadens globos ignis rubro paene albos Lumian et laminae venti viridis pallidae Mr. K.

source: Amidst the rumbling explosion, Ultraman Lato Guiaro was equally infuriated by Mad Lady’s actions.
target: Inter fragorem explosionis, Ultraman Lato Guiaro aeque irritatus est ob actus Mad Lady.

source: If he were still the temporary and complete Governor of the Sea, he wouldn’t fear the impact of the potent power in the spaceship.
target: Si adhuc gubernator Maris, temporarius et plenus, esset, impetum potentis potentiae in nave spatialis non timeret.

source: He hadn’t intended to release Mad Lady and use Bard’s silver ring.
target: Non intendebat Mad Lady liberari et annulum argenteum Bard adhibere.

source: However, the situation had changed.
target: Attamen, res mutata est.

source: Juan Oro, burning his life and sacrificing flesh and blood, had contested him for the authority of the Governor of the Sea.
target: Juan Oro, vitam suam ardenter comburens et carnem sanguisque sacrificans, de auctoritate Gubernatoris Maris cum eo contendit.

source: In this state, Ultraman couldn’t be certain if he was fully protected or if he would suffer some level of damage.
target: In hoc statu, Ultraman certus esse non poterat utrum plene protegeretur aut aliquam laesionem caperet.

source: Furthermore, not being a true demigod, he wasn’t sure if he could withstand such a blow, one that left him only injured.
target: Praeterea, non vere semideus, non certus erat num talem ictum sustinere posset, qui eum solum vulneratum reliquisset.

source: He couldn’t help but urge Mad Lady with his eyes, but his companion was ‘teleporting’ and didn’t have time to meet his gaze.
target: Conatus est oculis Mad Lady hortari, sed comes eius se teletransportabat et tempus oculis eius contingendi non habebat.

source: The humanoid Sealed Artifact remained immersed in distant chanting in the darkness, oblivious to the impending sea’s fury.
target: Artifactum sigillatum humanoide in canto procul in tenebris immersum manebat, obliviosum imminenti irae maris.

source: In the blink of an eye, corporeal starlight surged from the silver-gray behemoth at the bottom of the sea.
target: In ictu oculi, lumen astrale corporeum ex behemotho argenteo-griseo in fundo maris surrexit.

source: It followed the condensed energy passageway and struck the betrothal ship with a tsunami-like sound, aiming to devour everything around it.
target: Illud viam energiae condensatae secutus est et navem sponsaliti per sonum tsunami similem percussit, intendens omnia circa se vorare.

source: “Here it comes!” Mad Lady eagerly prepared for her extreme escape.
target: «Ecce venit!» Mad Lady ardenter ad extremum effugium se praeparavit.

source: Confronted with the immense wave of starlight, Lumian’s initial reaction was, Why is there another sea’s fury?
target: Confrontatus immensa unda luminis astralis, prima responsio Lumian fuit: "Cur alia ira maris est?"

source: Relying on his combat instincts, he immediately extended his spirituality to the Lie earring on his left ear, activating the high-level stealing power attached to the mystical item.
target: Confidens in instinctibus pugnae, statim spiritualitatem suam extendit ad ornamentum "Lie" in aure sinistra, potentiam furtandi altioris gradus adhaerentem item mysticum activans.

source: The starlight in his eyes took on a more tangible form, as if it had materialized.
target: Lumen astrale in oculis eius magis tangibilis formam suscepit, quasi materializatum esset.

source: Lumian’s raised left hand subtly twisted his wrist.
target: Manus sinistra elevata, Lumian carpum suum subtile contorsit.

source: The starlight surging from the silver-gray behemoth changed its course, rushing towards Lumian in waves, engulfing the sky and the sea.
target: Lumen astrale, a behemotho argenteo-griseo effluente, cursum mutavit, fluctibus versus Lumian properans, caelum et mare vorans.

source: This was even more terrifying than the previous sea’s rage.
target: Hoc etiam terribilius erat quam ira maris praeterita.

source: At that moment, Lumian felt as if an apocalypse had descended.
target: In illo momento, Lumian sensit quasi apocalypsis descenderet.

source: He knew very well that he couldn’t absorb all the stolen power himself.
target: Sciebat bene se totam potentiam furtam ipsi absorbere non posse.

source: Doing so would render him unable to endure, crushed into rotten meat on the spot, indirectly aiding Termiboros in escaping His predicament.
target: Hoc faciens, ipse totam potentiam non sustinere posset, quasi in loco in carnes putridas redactus, atque sic Termiboro indirecte auxilium praestaret ad evadendum ex sua condicione.

source: Fortunately, the stolen power linked to “honoring the ancestors” had the ability to disperse the boon obtained and share it with everyone present and all those with the sea bloodlines in Port Santa, similar to every successful sea prayer ritual.
target: Fortunate, potentia furtiva, ad maiores honorandos alligata, facultatem habebat bonum receptum diffundere et cum omnibus adstantibus atque cum omnibus qui sanguine maris in Port Santa sunt communicare, sicut in omni rito orationis maris feliciter confecto.

source: Though a bit greedy and reluctant, Lumian restrained himself.
target: Quamquam paulo avarus et reticentis animo, Lumian se cohibuit.

source: Without hesitation, he opened his left hand, seemingly grasping something, and twisted his wrist in the opposite direction.
target: Sine dubitatione, manum sinistram aperuit, quasi aliquid capiens, et carpum in contrariam partem contorsit.

source: Suddenly, the starlight that had darkened the sky and sea seemed to explode from within, scattering radiant starlight in every direction.
target: Subito, lumen astrale, quod caelum et mare obscuraverat, quasi ex intimo explodit, radiante lumen astrale in omnes partes disseminans.

source: “The stars are raining…” Franca, concealed in the cabin on the sailboat, lamented.
target: «Stellae pluant...» Franca, abscondita in cella navis sub vela, lamentabatur.

source: She tightly clutched the Major Arcana card belonging to Judgment in her hand.
target: Arcte tenebat chartam Major Arcana iudicii in manu sua.

source: This wasn’t a plea for Madam Judgment to descend directly.
target: Hoc non erat precatio ut Domina Iudicium directe demergeretur.

source: After all, this wasn’t within her jurisdiction.
target: Postremo, hoc non intra eius iurisdictionem pertinebat.

source: It was to signal the location for the Major Arcana card holders who had already gathered nearby.
target: Id ad locum signandum destinatum erat pro possessoribus chartae Major Arcana, qui iam prope congregati erant.

source: The beams of starlight left dazzling trails as they penetrated the bodies of those nearby and soared towards the bloodline connections farther away.
target: Radia luminis astralis vestigia fulgida relinquebant, dum corpora proximorum penetrabant et versus nexus sanguinis remotiora volabant.

source: Lumian couldn’t control this process, so he could only sense a portion of the starlight landing on him, causing his left chest to burn and corrode his flesh.
target: Lumian hunc processum regere non potuit, ergo solum partem luminis astralis, quae in eum incidebat, sentire potuit, quod sinus sinistrum eius ardebatur et carnem eius corrumpere faciebat.

source: Simultaneously, he witnessed a significant amount of starlight being drawn towards the potent sea bloodline and the authority of the Governor of the Sea, surging towards Ultraman and Juan Oro.
target: Simul, testimonium perhibuit quantitatem ingentem luminis astralis, quae ad potentem sanguinem maris atque ad auctoritatem Gubernatoris Maris trahebatur, versus Ultraman et Juan Oro properantem.

source: Undoubtedly, the humanoid Sealed Artifact received the most boons.
target: Indubitanter, Artifactum sigillatum humanoide maxima beneficia accepit.

source: Like the eye of a vortex, she incessantly absorbed the surrounding starlight.
target: Sicut oculus vortex, illa circumstantem lumen astrale sine intermissione absorbat.

source: Even the starlight heading towards Hela’s sailboat diminished noticeably.
target: Etiam lumen astrale, quod ad navem Helae vela tendebat, notabiliter decrebuit.

source: Ultraman experienced a replenishment, breaking free from his weakened state after Juan Oro’s two beams, swiftly reclaiming the authority of the Governor of the Sea.
target: Ultraman repletionem sensit, ex statu debilitato post duas radios Juan Oro evasit, et celeriter auctoritatem Gubernatoris Maris repetivit.

source: In his moment of elation, Ultraman Lato Guiaro felt intense surprise and confusion.
target: In momento exsultationis, Ultraman Lato Guiaro vehementer admirationem et confusionem sensit.

source: Why can Lumian Lee also steal the spacecraft’s power?
target: Cur etiam Lumian Lee potentiam navis spatialis furari potest?

source: That requires a high-level stealing ability…
target: Id requirit facultatem furtandi altissimo gradu…

source: Hasn’t Bard’s ring already been placed on the altar to honor the ancestors? And we’ve confirmed its corresponding effects.
target: Num annulus Bard iam in altare ad maiores honorandos positus non est? Et effectus eius correspondentes confirmavimus.

source: Isn’t the enchantment only possible once a year?
target: Num incantatio tantum semel in anno fieri non potest?

source: Amidst the echoing shock, Lato Guiaro couldn’t be bothered to ponder the answer.
target: Inter resonantem stupefactum, Lato Guiaro responsum meditari non curavit.

source: His instinctive reaction was to swiftly crush Juan Oro.
target: Instinctiva responsio eius fuit Juan Oro celeriter destruere.

source: Otherwise, who knew what he, now strengthened, would do!
target: Alioquin, quis sciret quid ipse, nunc roboratus, ageret!

source: At that moment, Juan Oro felt a surge of regained strength.
target: In illo momento, Juan Oro vim recuperatam sensit.

source: He observed his cracked chest and hazy flesh, now covered in starlight scales, with blood flowing out dyed in a resplendent "color."
target: Animadvertit pectus eius fissum et carnem obscuram, nunc squamis luminis astralis opertum, cum sanguine effuso, colore splendidissimo tincto.

source: Gazing at Lato Guiaro, he suddenly smiled—a smile of relief, yearning, and evident anger.
target: Intuens Lato Guiaro, subito subridit—risus levationis, desiderii et manifestae irae expressus est.

source: His body underwent a rapid transformation, eyes turning vertical, scales growing, and limbs thickening.
target: Corpus eius celeriter transformatum est, oculi verticaliter conversi, squamae creverunt, et membra crassiora facta sunt.

source: In the span of a breath, he morphed into a humanoid lizard.
target: In unius spiraculi spatio, in lacertam humanoidem mutatus est.

source: During this process, Lato Guiaro condensed a dark-green light that descended on Juan Oro in a series of rays.
target: Durante hoc processu, Lato Guiaro lucem viridem obscuram condensavit, quae in Juan Oro in seriem radiorum descendit.

source: Juan Oro made no attempt to dodge; he endured it.
target: Juan Oro conatum vitandi non fecit; id sustinuit.

source: His aura rapidly weakened, precisely as he desired.
target: Aura eius celeriter debilitata est, prorsus ut ipse desideraverat.

source: His lizard-like form faded, growing increasingly translucent, as if condensed from starlight.
target: Forma eius, lacertae similis, evanuit, et magis magisque translucida facta est, quasi ex lumine astrali condensata.

source: Then, Juan Oro merged into the void representing the sea and spoke to Lato Guiaro with a complex expression, "I’ve returned to the sea. Come quickly too…"
target: Deinde, Juan Oro in vacuum, quod mare repraesentabat, se coniunxit et Lato Guiaro, vultu multiplex, dixit: "Redii ad mare. Cito quoque veni…"

source: At the last few words, Juan Oro gnashed his teeth, not concealing his deep‐seated hatred.
target: Ad ultimas verba, Juan Oro dentes strinxit, profundum odium suum non celans.

source: Every Child of the Sea was prepared to return to the sea, and Juan Oro was no exception.
target: Omnis Puer Maris ad mare redire paratus erat, et Juan Oro non exceptione fuit.

source: However, he hadn’t anticipated doing so in this manner.
target: Attamen, non praevidit se hoc modo id facturum esse.

source: His sole desire now was for Lato Guiaro to join him!
target: Unicum eius desiderium nunc erat ut Lato Guiaro se illi coniunget!

source: Juan Oro’s figure dissipated, becoming entirely a part of the “sea.”
target: Figura Juan Oro dissipata est, totum in partem "maris" redacta.

source: Ultraman Lato Guiaro immediately sensed a growing animosity between his title as Governor of the Sea and the waters.
target: Ultraman Lato Guiaro statim sensit crescente inimicitiā inter titulum suum Gubernatoris Maris et aquas.

source: The harmony that once existed had given way to a resistance emanating from the Power of the Sea.
target: Concordia, quae olim exsistebat, cessavit, cedens locum resistentiae emanantis ex Potestate Maris.

source: This indicated that the Governor of the Sea authority he had acquired wouldn’t be complete for some time.
target: Hoc indicabat auctoritatem Gubernatoris Maris, quam adeptus erat, per aliquod tempus non plene futuram esse.

source: Damned old fellow! Lato Guiaro cursed inwardly, but he remained composed.
target: Maledictus senex! Lato Guiaro intus maledixit, sed compositus mansit.

source: He had realized that Hela was the sole demigod on the sailboat.
target: Animadvertit Helam solam unicam semideum in nave vela esse.

source: The humanoid Sealed Artifact, having received a boon from the sea and escaped the influence of the chanting, was sufficient to hold off the opposition for a while.
target: Artifactum sigillatum humanoide, beneficium a mari receptum et cantionis influxu evasit, satis erat ad oppositionem aliquantisper sustentandam.

source: Though uncertain why Gandalf and the others hadn’t arrived, Ultraman Lato Guiaro welcomed this turn of events.
target: Quamquam incertus erat cur Gandalf et ceteri non venerint, Ultraman Lato Guiaro hanc reversionem eventuum excipiebat.

source: It allowed him to focus on dealing with Lumian Lee and his ally!
target: Id ei permisit ut se concentreret in negotio cum Lumian Lee et socio eius.

source: Despite being an incomplete Governor of the Sea, he possessed enough strength to control adversaries below the demigod level briefly and gain entry to the spaceship first.
target: Quamvis Gubernator Maris imperfectus esset, satis vim habebat ad regendos adversarios infra gradum semideorum breviter et ut primus in navem spatialis ingrediret.

source: Moreover, Mad Lady’s assistance added to his advantage.
target: Praeterea, auxilium Mad Lady ei commodum addidit.

source: Having received the sea’s boon, Lumian contemplated his newfound capabilities.
target: Beneficium maris receptum, Lumian facultates novas suas consideravit.

source: Now, I seem qualified to contend for the authority of the Governor of the Sea…
target: Nunc videor idoneus esse pro auctoritate Gubernatoris Maris contenderere…

source: Although I can’t be considered to possess the sea bloodline and only wield some power of the sea lasting a week, far inferior to Ultraman, my fake level is high enough. I’m at the Angel level!
target: Etsi non possum dici me sanguinem maris habere et solum aliquam potentiam maris, quae hebdomada perdurat, exercere, longe inferior Ultramano, gradus meus fictus satis altus est. Sum ad gradum Angeli!

source: Just as Ultraman Lato Guiaro and Lumian responded swiftly, the gray sky suddenly brightened.
target: Sicut Ultraman Lato Guiaro et Lumian celeriter respondebant, caelum griseum subito illustratum est.

source: Thick bluish-green vines descended, shrouding the two ships and the surrounding area in torrential rain.
target: Vites densae viride-caeruleae descendebant, duas naves et circumstantem locum in imbre torrenti tegentes.

source: Soon, they intertwined into a giant-like forest growing above the sea.
target: Mox inter se implicatae sunt in silvam gigantescam, quae supra mare crescebat.
